shots.prompt: Close-up of a 35-year-old man with short tousled dark brown hair, blue eyes, light stubble and a small X-shaped scar on his cheek, wearing a pale weathered leather jacket. He slowly turns his head toward the camera, blinks, and looks straight into the lens with a calm, tired expression. A light wind moves strands of his hair. The camera slowly pushes in.
